description: How accounts link to budgets (see main.zhang): the activity of each budget, its accounts, and the budgets of each posting.

known_issues.activity: KNOWN-ISSUE: a posting to an Income (or Equity) account linked to a budget counts negated, so the refund of 15 CNY booked to Income:Refunds adds 15 CNY to Food's activity instead of taking it off, and income linked to a budget would count as spending; negation suits Liabilities (a card charge is spending), the rule applies it to every account with a negative sign (zhang-query/src/table/budgets.rs:36-37, 351)
